result:
Compiled successfully. Summary:

- Wrote `tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 3.8 test class (`extends junit.framework.TestCase`, no annotations, no diamond/lambda/underscore-literal syntax) covering `org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat` per its javadoc contract in `api/`.
- Coverage includes: all 9 predefined format field settings (`DEFAULT`, `EXCEL`, `RFC4180`, `TDF`, `MYSQL`, `INFORMIX_UNLOAD[_CSV]`, `POSTGRESQL_CSV`/`_TEXT`), `newFormat` defaults and its line-break-delimiter rejection, `valueOf` for all predefined names plus unknown-name (`IllegalArgumentException`) and `null` (`NullPointerException`) cases, `equals`/`hashCode` contract, `format(...)` quoting/escaping/empty-args behavior, header/header-comments getters (including defensive-copy verification), the `char`/`Character` with-methods for comment marker, escape, and quote (including null-disable and line-break-rejection boundary cases), record separator validation (valid CR/LF/CRLF vs. invalid strings), all boolean toggle `with*` methods, `is*Set` flags, `toString`, the `print`/`println`/`printRecord` family against in-memory `Appendable`s (with weaker existence-only checks for the `File`/`Path` overloads to avoid asserting on unflushed-buffer implementation details), and `parse(Reader)` iteration behavior (grounded in the package-level javadoc example showing `CSVParser`/`CSVRecord` are `Iterable`).
- `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`, and the expected `.class` files were produced.

Note: I deliberately skipped dedicated tests for `withHeader(ResultSet)`/`withHeader(ResultSetMetaData)` since faithfully stubbing those JDBC interfaces added a lot of risk/boilerplate for low marginal value; every other public member of `CSVFormat` has coverage.
